# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, x):
#         self.val = x
#         self.next = None


class Solution:
    def reverseList(self, head: ListNode) -> ListNode:
        dummy = ListNode()
        curr = head
        while curr:
            next = curr.next
            curr.next = dummy.next
            dummy.next = curr
            curr = next
        return dummy.next
